lines: Rooth gaya, ab us ka haal bataayen kya?
couplets.en: It turned away, and what can we say of it now?

lines: Woh ishq jo hum se rooth gaya, ab us ka haal bataayen kya?
couplets.en: What can we say now of the love that turned away from us?

lines: Koi mehr nahin, koi qahr nahin, phir sachcha sher sunaayen kya?
couplets.en: With neither tenderness nor wrath, what true verse can we recite?

lines: Woh ishq jo hum se rooth gaya.

lines: Ik hijr jo hum ko laahaq hai, taa-der use dohraayen kya?
couplets.en: Why keep telling of the separation that still afflicts us?

lines: Ik hijr jo hum ko laahaq hai, taa-der use dohraayen kya?

couplets.en: Why keep speaking of this separation or still indulge the poison we took to heart?

lines: Ik aag gham-e-tanhaai ki, jo saare badan mein phail gayi.
